text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
SYRIA TIMES
- U.S. President Clinton says Hebron talks at "critical juncture".
- Further Israeli attacks on Lebanon.
- Washington to boost aid to lebanon.
- Israel, Palestinian National Authority back on track for Hebron talks.
- U.S. finds Israeli position "troubling", Egyptian President Mubarak says settlement policy dangerous.
- Former U.S. officials urge Israel to stop settlement expansion.
- Turkish Prime Minister Erbakan for good ties with Syria.
- Oman says Israeli policies block normal ties.
TISHREEN
- No change in U.S. policy towards the Middle East, White House criticises Israeli support for settlements.
- Bahrain's Emir calls for Arab solidarity.
- King Hussein of Jordan gets Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's phone call, Israeli Foreign Minister Levy to Amman on Thursday.
AL-THAWRA
- European Union expects bright future for cooperation with Syria.
- Washington and Paris affirm support to Lebanon.
AL-BAATH
- Palestinian security forces arrest 12 Palestinians.
- Iran welcomes resolutions of the European Union's summit.
